title: PK-DB: the pharmacokinetics database
description:
PK-DB is an open pharmacokinetics database for clinical and pre-clinical research. This repository contains the software for validating, storing, analyzing, and accessing curated study data.

Features include:

  • Study subjects, interventions, pharmacokinetic parameters, and timecourses
  • Scientific validation and unit normalization
  • Controlled vocabulary definitions and ontology annotations
  • Pharmacokinetic calculations from concentration-time profiles
  • REST API and web interface access

Source code: github.com/matthiaskoenig/pkdb. Documentation: PK-DB documentation. Curated study data are maintained separately in pkdb_data.

If you use PK-DB data or the web interface, cite Grzegorzewski et al., PK-DB: pharmacokinetics database for individualized and stratified computational modeling, Nucleic Acids Research (2021), doi:10.1093/nar/gkaa990. If you use the code, also cite the archived software release.

Source code is licensed under MIT; documentation is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Questions and problems can be reported in the issue tracker.
